tasks.description: In `orchestrator/mcp_tools.py:_ensure_gateway_session()`, add `pipeline_id="mcp-server"` to the `client.register_session()` call — the gateway already exempts sessions with a pipeline_id from the repos requirement
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Session registration succeeds without repos list

tasks.description: In `orchestrator/mcp_tools.py`, add an optional `repo` property (type: string, description: 'Checkpoint repository in owner/repo format, e.g. jwbron/egg-checkpoints') to both `list_checkpoints` and `search_checkpoints` tool input schemas
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Both tool schemas include the optional repo property

tasks.description: In `orchestrator/mcp_tools.py:_handle_list_checkpoints()` and `_handle_search_checkpoints()`, when `args.get('repo')` is present, append `source_repo=<value>` to the query params sent to the gateway checkpoint endpoint
tasks.acceptance_criteria: source_repo query param is forwarded to the gateway when repo is specified by the caller

tasks.description: Add/update tests in `orchestrator/tests/test_mcp_tools.py` covering: (1) _ensure_gateway_session passes pipeline_id='mcp-server', (2) list_checkpoints and search_checkpoints forward repo as source_repo query param
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All new and existing tests pass

pr.title: Fix checkpoint MCP tools failing with 'Missing repos list'
pr.description:
Fix list_checkpoints and search_checkpoints MCP tools that always fail with
"Missing repos list" by passing pipeline_id="mcp-server" during gateway session
registration. Also add optional repo parameter for explicit checkpoint repo targeting.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: unit tests for session registration with pipeline_id and repo param forwarding
- Manual: call list_checkpoints and search_checkpoints via MCP and verify they return checkpoint data
